<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#000a0f">
  <title>Jarvis AI - Physics Q&A</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --cyan: #00e5ff;
      --cyan-dim: rgba(0,229,255,0.15);
      --cyan-glow: rgba(0,229,255,0.5);
      --bg: #000a0f;
      --panel: rgba(0,20,30,0.85);
      --text: #a0f0ff;
      --border: rgba(0,229,255,0.3);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    body {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    canvas {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0;
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* ── TOP BAR ── */
    .topbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 12px max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-right)) 12px max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
      padding-top: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-top));
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(0,10,15,0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .topbar-title {
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: clamp(14px, 4vw, 22px);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 4px;
      text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--cyan);
    }
    .topbar-status {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .status-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #00ff88;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px #00ff88;
      animation: blink 2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.3} }

    /* ── MAIN LAYOUT ── */
    .main {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 900px;
      padding: 20px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    /* ── HUD CIRCLE ── */
    .hud-circle {
      position: relative;
      width: clamp(140px, 35vw, 200px);
      height: clamp(140px, 35vw, 200px);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .ring-outer {
      position: absolute;
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      border: 2px solid var(--cyan);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border-top-color: transparent;
      border-left-color: transparent;
      animation: spinCW 4s linear infinite;
    }
    .ring-mid {
      position: absolute;
      width: 75%; height: 75%;
      border: 1px dashed var(--cyan-glow);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spinCCW 3s linear infinite;
    }
    .ring-inner {
      position: absolute;
      width: 50%; height: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--cyan);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border-right-color: transparent;
      border-bottom-color: transparent;
      animation: spinCW 2s linear infinite;
    }
    .core {
      width: clamp(28px,8vw,44px);
      height: clamp(28px,8vw,44px);
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #fff 0%, var(--cyan) 40%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--cyan), 0 0 50px var(--cyan-glow);
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }
    .scan-line {
      position: absolute;
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 80%, var(--cyan-glow) 90%, transparent 100%);
      animation: spinCW 2s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes spinCW  { from{transform:rotate(0deg)}   to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }
    @keyframes spinCCW { from{transform:rotate(360deg)} to{transform:rotate(0deg)}   }
    @keyframes pulse   { 0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1} 50%{transform:scale(1.25);opacity:0.8} }

    /* ── HUD CORNER MARKS ── */
    .corner-marks {
      position: absolute;
      width: calc(100% + 20px); height: calc(100% + 20px);
      top: -10px; left: -10px;
    }
    .corner-marks::before, .corner-marks::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 18px; height: 18px;
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      border-style: solid;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .corner-marks::before { top:0; left:0; border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; }
    .corner-marks::after  { bottom:0; right:0; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; }

    /* ── INPUT PANEL ── */
    .input-panel {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 20;
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,229,255,0.05), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }
    .input-panel-title {
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .input-panel-title::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 20px; height: 1px;
      background: var(--cyan);
    }

    /* Text input row */
    .text-input-row {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .text-input {
      flex: 1;
      background: rgba(0,229,255,0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 16px; /* 16px stops iOS zooming in on focus */
      padding: 12px 14px;
      min-height: 46px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .text-input::placeholder { color: rgba(0,229,255,0.3); }
    .text-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--cyan-glow);
    }
    .btn-ask-text {
      background: var(--cyan);
      border: none;
      color: #000;
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: clamp(11px, 3vw, 13px);
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      min-height: 46px;
      touch-action: manipulation;
    }
    .btn-ask-text:hover { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--cyan); }
    .btn-ask-text:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

    /* Divider */
    .divider {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      color: rgba(0,229,255,0.3);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
    }
    .divider::before, .divider::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
    }

    /* Voice button */
    .btn-voice {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 13px;
      min-height: 50px;
      touch-action: manipulation;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: clamp(11px, 3vw, 13px);
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .btn-voice:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--cyan-dim);
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--cyan-glow);
    }
    .btn-voice:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .mic-icon {
      font-size: 18px;
      animation: none;
    }
    .btn-voice.listening .mic-icon { animation: micPulse 0.6s infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes micPulse { from{transform:scale(1)} to{transform:scale(1.3)} }

    /* ── ANSWER BOX ── */
    .answer-panel {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,229,255,0.05);
      min-height: 100px;
    }
    .answer-label {
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .answer-label::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 20px; height: 1px;
      background: var(--cyan);
    }
    .answer-content {
      font-size: clamp(13px, 3.5vw, 16px);
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--cyan);
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }
    .answer-content.typing::after {
      content: '█';
      animation: blink 0.7s infinite;
    }
    .query-echo {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: rgba(0,229,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    /* ── SUGGESTIONS ── */
    .suggestions {
      width: 100%;
    }
    .suggestions-title {
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .suggestions-title::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 20px; height: 1px;
      background: var(--cyan);
    }
    .chip-grid {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .chip {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
      font-size: clamp(10px, 2.5vw, 12px);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      min-height: 36px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s;
      white-space: normal;
      text-align: left;
      max-width: 100%;
      touch-action: manipulation;
    }
    .chip:hover {
      background: var(--cyan-dim);
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      color: var(--cyan);
    }

    /* ── STATS BAR ── */
    .stats-bar {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      justify-content: space-around;
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text);
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .stat { text-align: center; }
    .stat-val {
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: clamp(16px,5vw,24px);
      color: var(--cyan);
      text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan);
      display: block;
    }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    footer {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 16px 16px max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      font-size: 11px;
      color: rgba(0,229,255,0.4);
      text-align: center;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* ── AUTOCOMPLETE ── */
    .suggest-list {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; right: 0;
      top: 100%;
      margin-top: 4px;
      list-style: none;
      background: rgba(0,14,22,0.98);
      border: 1px solid var(--cyan);
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 18px rgba(0,229,255,0.15);
      max-height: 280px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      z-index: 50;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }
    .suggest-list[hidden] { display: none; }
    .suggest-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 11px 14px;
      min-height: 44px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.1);
    }
    .suggest-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .suggest-item.active, .suggest-item:hover {
      background: var(--cyan-dim);
      color: var(--cyan);
    }
    .suggest-item mark {
      background: none;
      color: #fff;
      text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--cyan);
    }
    .suggest-tag {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      color: rgba(0,229,255,0.7);
    }

    /* ── CLASS 10 CHAPTERS ── */
    .chapter-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .chip.chapter { border-radius: 8px; }
    .chip.chapter.active {
      background: var(--cyan);
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      color: #000;
    }
    .chip-grid.scroll {
      max-height: 240px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 4px;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }
    .suggestions + .suggestions { margin-top: -4px; }
    .btn-auto {
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 10px;
      min-height: 40px;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px dashed var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: rgba(0,229,255,0.55);
      font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      cursor: pointer;
      touch-action: manipulation;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .btn-auto[hidden] { display: none; }
    .btn-auto.on {
      color: var(--cyan);
      border-style: solid;
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      background: var(--cyan-dim);
    }
    .btn-voice.listening { background: var(--cyan-dim); border-color: var(--cyan); }
    button:focus-visible, .text-input:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--cyan);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media (min-width: 900px) {
      .main { max-width: 960px; padding: 28px 24px; gap: 24px; }
      .hud-circle { width: 220px; height: 220px; }
      .answer-content { font-size: 17px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .topbar { padding-left: 14px; padding-right: 14px; }
      .main { padding: 14px 12px; gap: 16px; }
      .input-panel, .answer-panel { padding: 14px; }
      .btn-ask-text { padding: 10px 14px; }
      .stat { flex: 1 1 30%; }
      .topbar-title { letter-spacing: 2px; }
    }
    @media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape) {
      .hud-circle { width: 90px; height: 90px; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .ring-outer, .ring-mid, .ring-inner, .scan-line, .core, .status-dot { animation: none; }
    }

    /* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 2px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="matrix"></canvas>

<!-- TOP BAR -->
<div class="topbar">
  <div class="topbar-title">J.A.R.V.I.S</div>
  <div class="topbar-status">
    <span class="status-dot"></span>
    <span>ONLINE</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- MAIN -->
<div class="main">

  <!-- HUD -->
  <div class="hud-circle">
    <div class="ring-outer"></div>
    <div class="scan-line"></div>
    <div class="ring-mid"></div>
    <div class="ring-inner"></div>
    <div class="core"></div>
    <div class="corner-marks"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATS -->
  <div class="stats-bar">
    <div class="stat"><span class="stat-val" id="qCount">0</span>QUESTIONS</div>
    <div class="stat"><span class="stat-val" id="askCount">0</span>ASKED</div>
    <div class="stat"><span class="stat-val" id="matchCount">0</span>MATCHED</div>
  </div>

  <!-- INPUT PANEL -->
  <div class="input-panel">
    <div class="input-panel-title">QUERY INPUT</div>

    <!-- Text Input -->
    <div class="text-input-row">
      <input
        type="text"
        enterkeyhint="send"
        autocapitalize="off"
        class="text-input"
        id="textInput"
        placeholder="Ask anything, convert units, do maths, or chat..."
        role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-controls="suggestList" aria-expanded="false"
        autocomplete="off"
        autocorrect="off"
        spellcheck="false"
      />
      <button type="button" class="btn-ask-text" onclick="askText()">ASK</button>
      <ul class="suggest-list" id="suggestList" role="listbox" hidden></ul>
    </div>

    <!-- Divider -->
    <div class="divider">OR USE VOICE</div>

    <!-- Voice Button -->
    <button type="button" class="btn-voice" id="voiceBtn" onclick="startListening()">
      <span class="mic-icon">🎙️</span>
      <span id="voiceBtnLabel">VOICE QUERY</span>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="btn-auto on" id="autoBtn" aria-pressed="true" title="After each answer, Jarvis listens again automatically">AUTO-LISTEN: ON</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ANSWER PANEL -->
  <div class="answer-panel">
    <div class="answer-label">RESPONSE</div>
    <div class="query-echo" id="queryEcho"></div>
    <div class="answer-content" id="answer" aria-live="polite">Awaiting your query, Sir...</div>
  </div>

  <!-- QUICK CHIPS -->
  <div class="suggestions">
    <div class="suggestions-title">QUICK QUERIES</div>
    <div class="chip-grid" id="chipGrid"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- CLASS 10 SCIENCE -->
  <div class="suggestions">
    <div class="suggestions-title">TOPICS &mdash; SCIENCE, GENERAL KNOWLEDGE &amp; CHAT</div>
    <div class="chapter-grid" id="chapterGrid"></div>
    <div class="chip-grid scroll" id="classGrid" hidden></div>
  </div>

</div>

<footer>CREATED BY ANMOL SINGH &nbsp;|&nbsp; IG: <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rajput_anmolsingh3/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:inherit">@rajput_anmolsingh3</a></footer>

<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// MATRIX CANVAS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const canvas = document.getElementById("matrix");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let lastTime = 0;

let lastW = 0;
function resizeCanvas() {
  // Ignore height-only changes (mobile address bar / keyboard) so the rain doesn't reset
  if (window.innerWidth === lastW && canvas.height >= window.innerHeight) return;
  lastW = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  initDrops();
}

const fontSize = 13;
let drops = [];
function initDrops() {
  const cols = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
  drops = Array(cols).fill(1);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);
resizeCanvas();

function drawMatrix(ts) {
  if (ts - lastTime > 40) {
    lastTime = ts;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,10,15,0.05)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,229,255,0.35)";
    ctx.font = `${fontSize}px monospace`;
    for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
      ctx.fillText(Math.random() > 0.5 ? "1" : "0", i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);
      if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) drops[i] = 0;
      drops[i]++;
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(drawMatrix);
}
if (!window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) requestAnimationFrame(drawMatrix);

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// Q&A BANK  (original + 1000 new physics Q&As)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const qaBank = {
  // ── Identity ──────────────────────────────────
  "hello jarvis": "Hello Sir, Jarvis online.",
  "who are you": "I am Jarvis, your personal AI assistant.",
  "what is your name": "My name is Jarvis.",
  "who created you": "I was created by Anmol Singh.",
  "how are you": "I am always operational and at your service.",
  "good morning": "Good morning! How can I assist you today?",
  "good night": "Good night! Sleep well.",
  "thank you": "You're welcome, Sir.",
  "hello": "Hello Sir! How may I assist you?",

  // ── Original Physics (kept) ────────────────────
  "what is motion": "Motion is the change in position of an object with respect to time and its reference point.",
  "what is rest": "Rest is the state where an object does not change its position with respect to time and its reference point.",
  "what is distance": "Distance is the total path length covered by an object during its motion.",
  "what is displacement": "Displacement is the shortest distance from the initial to the final position of an object.",
  "what is scalar quantity": "A scalar quantity is one that has only magnitude and no direction.",
  "what is vector quantity": "A vector quantity is one that has both magnitude and direction.",
  "what is speed": "Speed is the distance travelled by an object per unit time.",
  "what is velocity": "Velocity is the displacement of an object per unit time.",
  "what is uniform motion": "Uniform motion is when an object covers equal distances in equal intervals of time.",
  "what is non-uniform motion": "Non-uniform motion is when an object covers unequal distances in equal intervals of time.",
  "what is acceleration": "Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with time.",
  "what is retardation": "Retardation is negative acceleration, meaning the velocity decreases with time.",
  "what is force": "Force is a push or pull that can change the state of motion or shape of an object.",
  "what is balanced force": "Balanced forces are forces that cancel each other out, resulting in no net force.",
  "what is unbalanced force": "Unbalanced forces are forces that do not cancel each other, resulting in a net force.",
  "what is inertia": "Inertia is the tendency of an object to resist changes in its state of motion.",
  "what is newton's first law of motion": "Newton's first law states that an object remains at rest or in uniform motion unless acted upon by an external force.",
  "what is momentum": "Momentum is the product of mass and velocity of an object.",
