  concept("Eng2: Control Systems", `
an open-loop system|a system whose output has no effect on the control action
a closed-loop system|a system in which feedback from the output is used to adjust the control action
a transfer function|the ratio of the Laplace transform of the output to that of the input with zero initial conditions
poles of a system|the values of s that make the transfer function infinite (roots of the denominator)
zeros of a system|the values of s that make the transfer function zero (roots of the numerator)
the Routh–Hurwitz criterion|a method to check stability by examining the signs of the first column of the Routh array
a Bode plot|a graph of magnitude and phase of a frequency response against log frequency
the Nyquist criterion|a stability test based on the encirclements of −1 by the open-loop frequency response
steady-state error|the difference between the desired and actual output as time tends to infinity
the damping ratio|a measure of how oscillations decay in a system, with ζ < 1 being underdamped
settling time|the time taken for the response to remain within a tolerance band of the final value
rise time|the time taken for the response to rise from 10% to 90% of its final value
peak overshoot|the maximum amount by which the response exceeds its final value
a PID controller|a controller that combines proportional, integral and derivative actions
negative feedback|feedback that subtracts the output from the input and improves stability
gain margin|the factor by which gain can be increased before the system becomes unstable
phase margin|the extra phase lag needed to make a system marginally stable at gain crossover
a root locus|a plot of the closed-loop poles as the loop gain varies
a state-space model|a representation of a system using first-order differential equations in state variables
a servomechanism|a feedback control system that controls position, velocity or acceleration
`, "control systems");
  concept("Eng2: Power Systems", `

diversity factor|the ratio of the sum of individual maximum demands to the maximum demand of the whole system
plant capacity factor|the ratio of actual energy produced to the maximum possible energy over a period
the per-unit system|expressing quantities as fractions of chosen base values
a substation|a facility that transforms voltage and switches power between lines
a surge arrester|a device that protects equipment from lightning and switching surges
string efficiency|the ratio of voltage across the whole insulator string to n times the voltage across the unit nearest the conductor
sag in a transmission line|the vertical distance between the highest support point and the lowest point of the conductor
a bundled conductor|two or more conductors per phase used to reduce corona loss and reactance
the Ferranti effect|the rise in receiving-end voltage over sending-end voltage on a lightly loaded long line
a protective relay|a device that detects faults and signals the circuit breaker to trip
a Buchholz relay|a gas-actuated relay that protects oil-filled transformers
a pumped storage plant|a hydro plant that pumps water uphill at off-peak times and generates at peak times
a thermal power plant|a plant that burns fuel to make steam that drives a turbine
a nuclear power plant|a plant that uses heat from nuclear fission to make steam
a distribution system|the part of the power system that delivers power from substations to consumers

a combinational circuit|a circuit whose output depends only on the present inputs
a sequential circuit|a circuit whose output depends on present inputs and past states
setup time|the time before the clock edge that the input must be stable
hold time|the time after the clock edge that the input must remain stable
propagation delay|the time taken for a change at the input to appear at the output
fan-out|the number of gate inputs a gate output can drive
noise margin|the amount of noise a logic circuit can tolerate without error
a Karnaugh map|a graphical method for simplifying Boolean expressions
a half adder|a circuit that adds two bits and gives sum and carry
a full adder|a circuit that adds three bits (two inputs and a carry-in) and gives sum and carry
De Morgan's theorem|the complement of a product is the sum of complements, and vice versa
a Schmitt trigger|a comparator circuit with hysteresis
a shift register|a group of flip-flops that shifts stored bits on each clock pulse
a ring counter|a shift register in which the last output is fed back to the first input
a Johnson counter|a shift register in which the inverted last output is fed back to the first input
an asynchronous counter|a counter in which flip-flops are triggered by the previous stage rather than a common clock
sampling|converting a continuous signal into discrete samples
quantisation|mapping sample values to a finite set of levels
aliasing|distortion that occurs when a signal is sampled below the Nyquist rate
time division multiplexing|sharing a channel by assigning each signal separate time slots
frequency division multiplexing|sharing a channel by assigning each signal a separate frequency band
baud rate|the number of signal changes per second
ASK|a modulation in which the amplitude of the carrier carries the data
FSK|a modulation in which the frequency of the carrier carries the data
PSK|a modulation in which the phase of the carrier carries the data
spread spectrum|spreading a signal over a wider bandwidth to resist interference
an optical fibre|a thin glass or plastic strand that carries light by total internal reflection
attenuation|the loss of signal strength over distance
dispersion|the spreading of a pulse as it travels along a channel
a waveguide|a hollow metal structure that carries microwaves
an antenna|a device that radiates or receives electromagnetic waves
`, "digital and communication engineering");
  concept("Eng2: OS, DBMS and Networks", `
FCFS scheduling|the process that arrives first is served first

round robin scheduling|each process gets a fixed time quantum in a cyclic order
priority scheduling|the process with the highest priority is executed first
context switching|saving the state of one process and loading the state of another
a system call|a request from a program to the operating system kernel
the kernel|the core of the operating system that controls hardware and processes
thrashing|excessive paging that leaves the CPU spending more time swapping than executing
Belady's anomaly|an increase in page faults when the number of frames increases in FIFO page replacement
RAID|a technology that combines several disks for performance or redundancy
a page fault|an event when a program accesses a page that is not in memory
first normal form|a table in which every attribute holds atomic values
second normal form|a table in first normal form with no partial dependency on the primary key
third normal form|a table in second normal form with no transitive dependency

const bcaKeys = new Set();
(function bcaPack() {
  const G = {};
  const put = (g, k, a) => { k = k.toLowerCase().trim(); if (k in qaBank) return; qaBank[k] = a; bcaKeys.add(k); (G[g] = G[g] || []).push(k); };
  const R = s => s.trim().split("\n").map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(r => r.split("|"));
  const gen = (g, rows, phr) => rows.forEach(r => phr.forEach(f => { const o = f(...r); if (o) put(g, o[0], o[1]); }));
  const up = s => s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  const defs = (g, rows, suf) => gen(g, R(rows), [
    (t, d) => [`what is ${t}`, `${up(t)}: ${d}.`], (t, d) => [`define ${t}`, `${up(t)}: ${d}.`], (t, d) => [`${t} definition`, `${up(t)}: ${d}.`],

  ]);

  for (let a = 1; a <= 10; a++) for (let b = 1; b <= 10; b++) {
    [`${a} & ${b} in c`, `bitwise and of ${a} and ${b}`].forEach(k => put(CO, k, `${a} & ${b} = ${a & b}.`));
    [`${a} | ${b} in c`, `bitwise or of ${a} and ${b}`].forEach(k => put(CO, k, `${a} | ${b} = ${a | b}.`));
    [`${a} ^ ${b} in c`, `bitwise xor of ${a} and ${b}`].forEach(k => put(CO, k, `${a} ^ ${b} = ${a ^ b}.`)); }
  for (let a = 1; a <= 20; a++) for (let s = 1; s <= 3; s++) { [`${a} << ${s} in c`, `left shift ${a} by ${s}`].forEach(k => put(CO, k, `${a} << ${s} = ${a << s}.`)); [`${a} >> ${s} in c`, `right shift ${a} by ${s}`].forEach(k => put(CO, k, `${a} >> ${s} = ${a >> s}.`)); }

    put(CO, `value of ${a} * ${b} + ${c} in c`, `${a} * ${b} + ${c} = ${a * b + c}.`);
    put(CO, `value of (${a} + ${b}) * ${c} in c`, `(${a} + ${b}) * ${c} = ${(a + b) * c}.`); }

const bca3Keys = new Set();
(function bca3Pack() {

  const R = s => s.trim().split("\n").map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(r => r.split("|"));
  const fmt = x => String(Math.round(x * 100) / 100);
  const lcg = seed => { let x = seed * 2654435761 % 2147483647 || 1; return () => (x = (x * 48271) % 2147483647); };
  const distinct = (seed, n, lo, hi) => { const g = lcg(seed), s = []; while (s.length < n) { const v = lo + g() % (hi - lo + 1); if (!s.includes(v)) s.push(v); } return s; };
  const A = a => "[" + a.join(", ") + "]";

  // ── Sorting by hand

    const b = [...L]; let swaps = 0; for (let j = 0; j < b.length - 1; j++) if (b[j] > b[j + 1]) { [b[j], b[j + 1]] = [b[j + 1], b[j]]; swaps++; }
    [`bubble sort first pass on ${s}`, `after the first pass of bubble sort on ${s}`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `After pass 1 of bubble sort: ${A(b)} (the largest element ${Math.max(...L)} moves to the end).`));
    let inv = 0; for (let x = 0; x < L.length; x++) for (let y = x + 1; y < L.length; y++) if (L[x] > L[y]) inv++;
    [`number of swaps in bubble sort of ${s}`, `how many swaps does bubble sort make on ${s}`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `Bubble sort makes ${inv} swaps on ${s} (the number of inversions).`));
    const c = [...L]; let mi = 0; c.forEach((v, j) => { if (v < c[mi]) mi = j; }); [c[0], c[mi]] = [c[mi], c[0]];
    [`selection sort first pass on ${s}`, `after the first pass of selection sort on ${s}`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `After pass 1 of selection sort: ${A(c)} (minimum ${Math.min(...L)} placed first).`));
    [`insertion sort after 3 elements on ${s}`, `after inserting the first three elements in insertion sort of ${s}`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `After the first three elements are sorted: ${A([...L.slice(0, 3)].sort((p, q) => p - q).concat(L.slice(3)))}.`));
    [`sort ${s} in ascending order`, `sorted order of ${s}`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `${A([...L].sort((p, q) => p - q))}.`));
    [`sort ${s} in descending order`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `${A([...L].sort((p, q) => q - p))}.`));
  }
  for (let n = 2; n <= 40; n++) [`number of comparisons in bubble sort of ${n} elements`, `how many comparisons does bubble sort make for ${n} elements`].forEach(k => put(SO, k, `Without early exit, bubble sort makes n(n−1)/2 = ${n * (n - 1) / 2} comparisons for n = ${n}.`));

  // ── BST traversals
  const BT = "BCA3: Binary Search Trees";
  const ins = (t, v) => !t ? { v, l: null, r: null } : (v < t.v ? { ...t, l: ins(t.l, v) } : { ...t, r: ins(t.r, v) });
  const ino = t => t ? [...ino(t.l), t.v, ...ino(t.r)] : [], pre = t => t ? [t.v, ...pre(t.l), ...pre(t.r)] : [], post = t => t ? [...post(t.l), ...post(t.r), t.v] : [];
  const ht = t => t ? 1 + Math.max(ht(t.l), ht(t.r)) : 0, leaves = t => !t ? 0 : (!t.l && !t.r ? 1 : leaves(t.l) + leaves(t.r));
  for (let i = 1; i <= 120; i++) {
    const L = distinct(i + 500, 7, 1, 60), s = A(L); let t = null; L.forEach(v => t = ins(t, v));
    [`inorder traversal of the bst built by inserting ${s}`, `bst inorder of ${s}`].forEach(k => put(BT, k, `Inorder: ${ino(t).join(", ")} (always sorted for a BST).`));
    [`preorder traversal of the bst built by inserting ${s}`, `bst preorder of ${s}`].forEach(k => put(BT, k, `Preorder: ${pre(t).join(", ")}.`));
    [`postorder traversal of the bst built by inserting ${s}`, `bst postorder of ${s}`].forEach(k => put(BT, k, `Postorder: ${post(t).join(", ")}.`));
    [`height of the bst built by inserting ${s}`, `bst height for ${s}`].forEach(k => put(BT, k, `The tree has ${ht(t)} levels (height ${ht(t) - 1} counting edges).`));
    [`number of leaf nodes in the bst built by inserting ${s}`, `bst leaf count for ${s}`].forEach(k => put(BT, k, `The BST has ${leaves(t)} leaf nodes.`));
    [`root of the bst built by inserting ${s}`].forEach(k => put(BT, k, `The root is ${L[0]} (the first inserted value).`));
  }
  const DS = "BCA3: Data Structure Formulas";
  for (let h = 0; h <= 20; h++) [`maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height ${h}`, `max nodes in a binary tree with height ${h} edges`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `Maximum nodes = 2^(h+1) − 1 = ${2 ** (h + 1) - 1} (height counted in edges).`));
  for (let l = 1; l <= 20; l++) [`maximum number of nodes at level ${l} of a binary tree`, `max nodes at level ${l} in a binary tree`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `At most 2^(${l}−1) = ${2 ** (l - 1)} nodes at level ${l} (root at level 1).`));
  for (let n = 1; n <= 64; n++) [`minimum height of a binary tree with ${n} nodes`, `min levels of a binary tree with ${n} nodes`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `Minimum number of levels = ⌈log2(${n} + 1)⌉ = ${Math.ceil(Math.log2(n + 1))}.`));
  for (let n = 2; n <= 40; n++) { [`number of edges in a complete graph with ${n} vertices`, `edges in k${n}`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `K${n} has n(n−1)/2 = ${n * (n - 1) / 2} edges.`)); [`number of edges in a tree with ${n} nodes`, `edges in a tree of ${n} vertices`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `A tree with ${n} nodes has ${n - 1} edges.`)); [`number of edges in a complete directed graph with ${n} vertices`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `A complete directed graph has n(n−1) = ${n * (n - 1)} edges.`)); [`number of handshakes among ${n} people`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `Handshakes = n(n−1)/2 = ${n * (n - 1) / 2}.`)); }
  for (let n = 1; n <= 30; n++) { [`number of subsets of a set with ${n} elements`, `size of the power set of a set of ${n} elements`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `A set with ${n} elements has 2^${n} = ${2 ** n} subsets.`)); [`number of binary strings of length ${n}`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `There are 2^${n} = ${2 ** n} binary strings of length ${n}.`)); }
  for (let n = 4; n <= 30; n++) [`number of diagonals in a polygon with ${n} sides`].forEach(k => put(DS, k, `Diagonals = n(n−3)/2 = ${n * (n - 3) / 2}.`));

  // ── Stack, queue, postfix
  const SQ = "BCA3: Stack Queue Postfix";

    put(SQ, `enqueue ${v[0]} enqueue ${v[1]} enqueue ${v[2]} dequeue which element is at the front`, `Dequeue removes ${v[0]}; the front element is ${v[1]}.`);
    put(SQ, `enqueue ${v[0]} enqueue ${v[1]} enqueue ${v[2]} enqueue ${v[3]} dequeue twice what remains in the queue`, `After two dequeues, the queue holds ${v[2]}, ${v[3]} (front to rear).`);
  }
  const prec = { "+": 1, "-": 1, "*": 2, "/": 2, "^": 3 };
  const parse = src => { const tk = src.match(/[A-Z]|[+\-*\/^()]/g); let p = 0;
    const prim = () => { const t = tk[p++]; if (t === "(") { const e = expr(0); p++; return e; } return { v: t }; };
    const expr = min => { let l = prim(); while (p < tk.length && prec[tk[p]] >= min && prec[tk[p]]) { const op = tk[p++], nx = op === "^" ? prec[op] : prec[op] + 1; l = { op, l, r: expr(nx) }; } return l; };
    return expr(1); };
  const po = n => n.op ? po(n.l) + po(n.r) + n.op : n.v, pr = n => n.op ? n.op + pr(n.l) + pr(n.r) : n.v;
  const ops3 = ["+", "-", "*", "/", "^"], exprs = [];
  ops3.forEach(a => ops3.forEach(b => { exprs.push(`A ${a} B ${b} C`); exprs.push(`( A ${a} B ) ${b} C`); exprs.push(`A ${a} ( B ${b} C )`); }));
  ["+", "-", "*", "/"].forEach(a => ["+", "-", "*", "/"].forEach(b => ["+", "-", "*", "/"].forEach(c => exprs.push(`A ${a} B ${b} C ${c} D`))));
  exprs.forEach(e => { const t = parse(e), clean = e.replace(/ /g, ""), sp = e;
    [`convert ${sp} to postfix`, `postfix of ${sp}`, `infix ${clean} to postfix`].forEach(k => put(SQ, k, `Postfix of ${sp.replace(/ /g, "")}: ${po(t)}.`));
    [`convert ${sp} to prefix`, `prefix of ${sp}`, `infix ${clean} to prefix`].forEach(k => put(SQ, k, `Prefix of ${sp.replace(/ /g, "")}: ${pr(t)}.`)); });
  for (let a = 1; a <= 9; a++) for (let b = 1; b <= 9; b++) { [`evaluate the postfix expression ${a} ${b} +`].forEach(k => put(SQ, k, `${a} ${b} + = ${a + b}.`)); [`evaluate the postfix expression ${a} ${b} *`].forEach(k => put(SQ, k, `${a} ${b} * = ${a * b}.`)); if (a > b) put(SQ, `evaluate the postfix expression ${a} ${b} -`, `${a} ${b} - = ${a - b}.`); }
  for (let a = 2; a <= 7; a++) for (let b = 2; b <= 7; b++) for (let c = 2; c <= 7; c++) {

    put(SQ, `evaluate the postfix expression ${a} ${b} ${c} * +`, `${a} + (${b} × ${c}) = ${a + b * c}.`);

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// UI SETUP
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const answerEl   = document.getElementById("answer");
const queryEcho  = document.getElementById("queryEcho");
const textInput  = document.getElementById("textInput");
const voiceBtn   = document.getElementById("voiceBtn");
const voiceLabel = document.getElementById("voiceBtnLabel");
const qCountEl   = document.getElementById("qCount");
const askCountEl = document.getElementById("askCount");
const matchCountEl = document.getElementById("matchCount");

let askCount = 0, matchCount = 0;
const totalQ = Object.keys(qaBank).length;
qCountEl.textContent = totalQ;

// ── Quick chips ────────────────────────────────
const quickKeys = [
  "what is newton's first law of motion",
  "what is ohm's law",
  "what is the speed of light",
  "what is kinetic energy",
  "what is photoelectric effect",
  "what is bernoulli's principle",
  "what is entropy",
  "what is nuclear fission",
  "what is snell's law",
  "what is heisenberg uncertainty principle",
  "what is kepler's first law",
  "what is doppler effect",
  "what is archimedes principle",
  "what is escape velocity",
  "what is faraday's law",
  "what is the formula for kinetic energy",
  "what is the formula for momentum",
  "what is the formula for escape velocity from earth",
  "what is the value of g",
  "what is the value of planck's constant",
  "what is carnot efficiency",
  "what is the formula for time period of simple pendulum",
  "what is the rydberg formula",
  "what is the first equation of motion",
  "what is the formula for capacitors in series"
];
function chipLabel(k) {
  let t = k.replace(/^what is the /, "").replace(/^what is /, "").replace(/^what are /, "").replace(/^how /, "How ");
  return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1);
}
function makeChip(k, parent) {
  const chip = document.createElement("button");
  chip.type = "button";
  chip.className = "chip";
  chip.textContent = chipLabel(k);
  chip.onclick = () => processQuery(k);
  parent.appendChild(chip);
}
const chipGrid = document.getElementById("chipGrid");
quickKeys.forEach(k => makeChip(k, chipGrid));

// ── Class 10 chapter picker ────────────────────
const chapterGrid = document.getElementById("chapterGrid");
const classGrid = document.getElementById("classGrid");
let activeChapter = null;
Object.keys(chapterKeys).forEach(ch => {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.type = "button";
  b.className = "chip chapter";
  b.textContent = ch;
  b.onclick = () => {
    if (activeChapter === ch) {           // tap again to close
      activeChapter = null;
      classGrid.hidden = true;
      b.classList.remove("active");
      return;
    }
    activeChapter = ch;
    chapterGrid.querySelectorAll(".chapter").forEach(x => x.classList.toggle("active", x === b));
    classGrid.innerHTML = "";
    chapterKeys[ch].forEach(k => makeChip(k, classGrid));
    classGrid.hidden = false;
    classGrid.scrollTop = 0;
  };
  chapterGrid.appendChild(b);
});

// ── Autocomplete suggestions ───────────────────
const suggestList = document.getElementById("suggestList");
const allKeys = Object.keys(qaBank).filter(k => k.length > 3);
let suggestItems = [], suggestIdx = -1;

function escapeHtml(t) {
  return t.replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
}
function hideSuggest() {
  suggestList.hidden = true;
  suggestIdx = -1;
  textInput.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
}
function highlight() {
  [...suggestList.children].forEach((li, i) => li.classList.toggle("active", i === suggestIdx));
  const act = suggestList.children[suggestIdx];
  if (act && act.scrollIntoView) act.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
}
let _sugNorm = null;
function getSuggestions(raw) {
  const q = normalise(raw);
  if (q.length < 2) return [];
  const words = q.split(" ").filter(w => w && !STOP.has(w));
  const base = q.replace(/^(what is the |what is an |what is a |what is |what are |tell me about |explain |define )/, "");
  if (!words.length && !base) return [];
  const scored = [];
  if (!_sugNorm) _sugNorm = allKeys.map(k => normalise(k));
  for (let ki = 0; ki < allKeys.length; ki++) {
    const k = allKeys[ki], nk = _sugNorm[ki];
    let score = -1;
    if (nk.startsWith(q)) score = 0;
    else if (base && nk.replace(/^(what is the |what is an |what is a |what is |what are )/, "").startsWith(base)) score = 1;
    else if (words.length && words.every(w => nk.includes(w))) score = 2;
    if (score >= 0) scored.push({ k, score, len: k.length });
  }
  scored.sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score || a.len - b.len);
  return scored.slice(0, 7).map(x => x.k);
}
function showSuggest() {
  const raw = textInput.value;
  suggestItems = getSuggestions(raw);
  suggestList.innerHTML = "";
  if (!suggestItems.length) { hideSuggest(); return; }
  const words = normalise(raw).split(" ").filter(w => w.length > 1 && !STOP.has(w));
  suggestItems.forEach(k => {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    li.className = "suggest-item";
    li.setAttribute("role", "option");
    let html = escapeHtml(chipLabel(k));
    words.forEach(w => {
      const re = new RegExp("(" + w.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + ")", "ig");
      html = html.replace(re, "<mark>$1</mark>");
    });
    li.innerHTML = `<span>${html}</span>` + (flirtKeys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">FLIRTY</span>' : c11Keys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">CLASS 11</span>' : class10Keys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">CLASS 10</span>' : chatKeys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">CHAT</span>' : extraKeys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">GENERAL</span>' : convKeys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">CONVERT</span>' : physKeys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">PHYSICS</span>' : popKeys.has(k) ? '<span class="suggest-tag">POPULAR</span>' : "");
    // pointerdown so the input keeps focus and it works on touch screens
    li.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      hideSuggest();
      processQuery(k);
    });
    suggestList.appendChild(li);
  });
  suggestIdx = -1;
  suggestList.hidden = false;
  textInput.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
}
textInput.addEventListener("input", showSuggest);
textInput.addEventListener("focus", () => { if (textInput.value.trim().length >= 2) showSuggest(); });
textInput.addEventListener("blur", () => setTimeout(hideSuggest, 150));
document.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
  if (!e.target.closest(".text-input-row")) hideSuggest();
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// QUERY PROCESSING
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const STOP = new Set(["what","whats","is","are","the","a","an","of","in","to","me","tell","about","explain","define","please","jarvis","how","does","do","give","say","meaning","called"]);

const _normCache = new Map();
function normalise(s) {
  const hit = _normCache.get(s);
  if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
  const out = s.toLowerCase().trim()
    .replace(/[’‘`´]/g, "'")
    .replace(/\bwhat's\b/g, "what is")
    .replace(/\bwhats\b/g, "what is")
    .replace(/\b(kilo|centi|milli|micro|nano|deci)?meters?\b/g, (m, p) => (p || "") + "metre" + (m.endsWith("s") ? "s" : ""))
    .replace(/\b(milli|centi|deci|kilo)?liters?\b/g, (m, p) => (p || "") + "litre" + (m.endsWith("s") ? "s" : ""))
    .replace(/(\d)\.(\d)/g, "$1\u0001$2")          // keep decimal points inside numbers
    .replace(/['"?!.,;:()]/g, "")
    .replace(/\u0001/g, ".")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
  if (_normCache.size < 60000) _normCache.set(s, out);
  return out;
}

function stem(w) {
  return w.length > 3 && w.endsWith("s") && !w.endsWith("ss") ? w.slice(0, -1) : w;
}
function tokens(s) {
  return normalise(s).split(" ").filter(w => w && !STOP.has(w)).map(stem);
}

// Pre-compute token sets once (fast on phones)
const index = Object.keys(qaBank).map(key => {
  const set = new Set(tokens(key));
  const gen = convKeys.has(key) || physKeys.has(key) || c10Gen.has(key);
  const nums = gen ? [...set].filter(w => /^-?\d/.test(w)).sort().join(",") : null;
  return { key, set, gen, nums };
});
// Normalised exact-match lookup
const exact = {};
Object.keys(qaBank).forEach(k => { exact[normalise(k)] = k; });

function candidates(q) {
  const out = [q];
  const stripped = q.replace(/^(please |jarvis |can you |could you )+/, "")
                    .replace(/^(tell me about|tell me|explain|define|what are|what is|whats|describe|give me|state)\s+/, "")
                    .replace(/^(the|a|an)\s+/, "");
  out.push("what is " + stripped, "what is the " + stripped, "what are " + stripped);
  out.push(stripped);
  return out;
}


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// CALCULATOR & UNIT CONVERSION  (works on any numbers)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
function fmtNum(n) {
  if (!isFinite(n)) return null;
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e15) return null;
  return String(parseFloat(n.toFixed(6)));
}
function tryMath(raw) {
  let q = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[?,=]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    q = q.replace(/^(what is|what's|whats|calculate|compute|solve|find|tell me|how much is|jarvis|the value of|please)\s+/, "");
  }
  let m, r;
  if ((m = q.match(/^([\d.]+)\s*(?:percent|%) of ([\d.]+)$/)) && (r = fmtNum(m[1] * m[2] / 100))) return `${m[1]} percent of ${m[2]} is ${r}.`;
  if ((m = q.match(/^(?:the )?square root of ([\d.]+)$/)) && (r = fmtNum(Math.sqrt(+m[1])))) return `The square root of ${m[1]} is ${r}.`;
  if ((m = q.match(/^(?:the )?cube root of ([\d.]+)$/)) && (r = fmtNum(Math.cbrt(+m[1])))) return `The cube root of ${m[1]} is ${r}.`;
  if ((m = q.match(/^(?:the )?square of ([\d.]+)$/)) && (r = fmtNum(m[1] * m[1]))) return `The square of ${m[1]} is ${r}.`;
  if ((m = q.match(/^(?:the )?cube of ([\d.]+)$/)) && (r = fmtNum(m[1] * m[1] * m[1]))) return `The cube of ${m[1]} is ${r}.`;
  if ((m = q.match(/^(\d+) factorial$/)) && +m[1] <= 18) { let f = 1; for (let i = 2; i <= +m[1]; i++) f *= i; return `${m[1]} factorial is ${f}.`; }
  if ((m = q.match(/^(?:the )?(?:multiplication )?table of (\d+)$/)) && +m[1] <= 1000) {
    const n = +m[1], parts = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) parts.push(`${n} times ${i} is ${n * i}`);
    return parts.join(", ") + ".";
  }
  // unit conversions
  const conv = [
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:degrees? )?(?:celsius|centigrade) (?:to|in) fahrenheit$/, v => v * 9 / 5 + 32, "°F"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:degrees? )?fahrenheit (?:to|in) celsius$/, v => (v - 32) * 5 / 9, "°C"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:degrees? )?celsius (?:to|in) kelvin$/, v => v + 273.15, " K"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?kelvin (?:to|in) celsius$/, v => v - 273.15, "°C"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:km|kilometres?|kilometers?) (?:to|in) (?:miles?)$/, v => v * 0.621371, " miles"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?miles? (?:to|in) (?:km|kilometres?|kilometers?)$/, v => v * 1.609344, " kilometres"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:kg|kilograms?) (?:to|in) (?:pounds?|lbs?)$/, v => v * 2.204623, " pounds"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:pounds?|lbs?) (?:to|in) (?:kg|kilograms?)$/, v => v / 2.204623, " kilograms"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:m|metres?|meters?) (?:to|in) (?:feet|foot|ft)$/, v => v * 3.28084, " feet"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:feet|foot|ft) (?:to|in) (?:m|metres?|meters?)$/, v => v / 3.28084, " metres"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:m|metres?|meters?) (?:to|in) (?:cm|centimetres?|centimeters?)$/, v => v * 100, " centimetres"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:cm|centimetres?|centimeters?) (?:to|in) (?:m|metres?|meters?)$/, v => v / 100, " metres"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:km|kilometres?|kilometers?) (?:to|in) (?:m|metres?|meters?)$/, v => v * 1000, " metres"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:km\/h|kmph|kilometres? per hour) (?:to|in) (?:m\/s|metres? per second)$/, v => v / 3.6, " metres per second"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:m\/s|metres? per second) (?:to|in) (?:km\/h|kmph|kilometres? per hour)$/, v => v * 3.6, " kilometres per hour"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:litres?|liters?) (?:to|in) (?:ml|millilitres?|milliliters?)$/, v => v * 1000, " millilitres"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:hours?) (?:to|in) (?:minutes?)$/, v => v * 60, " minutes"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:minutes?) (?:to|in) (?:seconds?)$/, v => v * 60, " seconds"],
    [/^([-\d.]+) ?(?:days?) (?:to|in) (?:hours?)$/, v => v * 24, " hours"]
  ];
  for (const [re, fn, unit] of conv) {
    if ((m = q.match(re)) && (r = fmtNum(fn(+m[1])))) return `${q} is ${r}${unit}.`;
  }
  // plain arithmetic: "12 plus 5", "7 times 8", "100 / 4", "2 to the power of 10"
  let e = " " + q + " ";
  e = e.replace(/ multiplied by /g, " * ").replace(/ times /g, " * ")
       .replace(/ divided by /g, " / ").replace(/ over /g, " / ")
       .replace(/ plus /g, " + ").replace(/ minus /g, " - ")
       .replace(/ to the power of /g, " ** ").replace(/ raised to /g, " ** ")
       .replace(/(\d)\s*x\s*(\d)/g, "$1 * $2").replace(/\^/g, " ** ").trim();
  if (e.length < 60 && /^[\d\s+\-*/().]+$/.test(e) && /\d\s*(\*\*|[+\-*/])\s*[\d(]/.test(e)) {
    try {
      const val = Function('"use strict"; return (' + e + ")")();
      if (typeof val === "number" && (r = fmtNum(val))) return `${q.replace(/\s+/g, " ")} equals ${r}.`;
      if (typeof val === "number") return "That number is too large for me to say, Sir.";
    } catch (err) {}
  }
  return null;
}

// An answer can be plain text or a function (for live time, jokes, etc.)
function resolve(k) {
  const v = qaBank[k];
  return typeof v === "function" ? v() : v;
}

function findAnswer(query) {
  const q = normalise(query);
  for (const c of candidates(q)) {
    if (exact[c]) return { response: resolve(exact[c]), matched: true };
  }

  // Any-number unit conversion: "convert 2.5 km to m", "how many grams in a kilogram", "100 c to f"
  const conv = tryConvert(query);
  if (conv) return { response: conv, matched: true };

  // Calculator
  const calc = tryMath(query);
  if (calc) return { response: calc, matched: true };

  // Fuzzy matching: F1 score on meaningful words
  const qs = new Set(tokens(q));
  if (qs.size === 0) return { response: "I didn't catch that, Sir. Please ask a physics question.", matched: false };

  const qnums = [...qs].filter(w => /^-?\d/.test(w)).sort().join(",");
  let best = null, bestScore = 0;
  for (const item of index) {
    if (item.set.size === 0) continue;
    // generated numericals must match the numbers asked, never a similar-looking sum
    if (item.gen && item.nums !== qnums) continue;
    let hit = 0;
    qs.forEach(w => { if (item.set.has(w)) hit++; });
    if (!hit) continue;
    const p = hit / qs.size, r = hit / item.set.size;
    const score = (2 * p * r) / (p + r);
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = item.key; }
  }
  if (best && bestScore >= 0.6) {
    return { response: `(Closest match: "${best}")\n\n${resolve(best)}`, matched: true };
  }
  return { response: "I don't have that in my database yet, Sir. Try rephrasing or ask another physics question.", matched: false };
}

function typeText(text, el) {
  el.classList.remove("typing");
  el.textContent = text;
  el.style.opacity = "0";
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    el.style.transition = "opacity 0.18s";
    el.style.opacity = "1";
  });
}

function processQuery(query, fromVoice) {
  const q = query.trim();
  if (!q) return;
  // Typing while the mic is open: close the mic so it doesn't hear Jarvis
  if (!fromVoice && listening && recognition) { try { recognition.abort(); } catch (e) {} }
  // Saying "stop", "bye" etc. ends hands-free mode after Jarvis replies
  if (END_WORDS.has(normalise(q))) { conversationActive = false; noSpeechCount = 0; updateVoiceUI(); }

  askCount++;
  askCountEl.textContent = askCount;
  queryEcho.textContent = `> ${q}`;

  const { response, matched } = findAnswer(q);
  if (matched) { matchCount++; matchCountEl.textContent = matchCount; }

  typeText(response, answerEl);
  speak(response, afterSpeech);
  textInput.value = "";
  hideSuggest();
  // Make sure the answer is visible on small screens
  if (window.innerWidth < 700) {
    document.querySelector(".answer-panel").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// TEXT INPUT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
function askText() {
  const val = textInput.value.trim();
  if (!val) return;
  processQuery(val);
}
textInput.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  const open = !suggestList.hidden && suggestItems.length;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown" && open) {
    e.preventDefault();
    suggestIdx = (suggestIdx + 1) % suggestItems.length; highlight();
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp" && open) {
    e.preventDefault();
    suggestIdx = (suggestIdx - 1 + suggestItems.length) % suggestItems.length; highlight();
  } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
    hideSuggest();
  } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (open && suggestIdx >= 0) processQuery(suggestItems[suggestIdx]);
    else askText();
  }
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// VOICE INPUT  (hands-free: mic re-opens after each answer)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
let recognition = null;
let listening = false;          // mic is open right now
let conversationActive = false; // hands-free loop is running
let noSpeechCount = 0;
let speaking = false;
let resumeTimer = null;
let autoListen = true;
try { const v = localStorage.getItem("jarvisAutoListen"); if (v !== null) autoListen = v === "1"; } catch (e) {}

const autoBtn = document.getElementById("autoBtn");
function updateAutoUI() {
  autoBtn.textContent = "AUTO-LISTEN: " + (autoListen ? "ON" : "OFF");
  autoBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(autoListen));
  autoBtn.classList.toggle("on", autoListen);
}
function updateVoiceUI() {
  voiceBtn.classList.toggle("listening", listening);
  voiceLabel.textContent = listening ? "LISTENING... (TAP TO STOP)"
                         : conversationActive ? "TAP TO STOP"
                         : "VOICE QUERY";
}
updateAutoUI();
autoBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  autoListen = !autoListen;
  try { localStorage.setItem("jarvisAutoListen", autoListen ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}
  updateAutoUI();
  if (!autoListen) stopConversation();
});

if (!SR) {
  voiceBtn.disabled = true;
  voiceLabel.textContent = "VOICE NOT SUPPORTED";
  autoBtn.hidden = true;
}

function stopConversation(msg) {
  conversationActive = false;
  noSpeechCount = 0;
  clearTimeout(resumeTimer);
  if (listening && recognition) { try { recognition.abort(); } catch (e) {} }
  updateVoiceUI();
  if (msg) { answerEl.textContent = msg; queryEcho.textContent = ""; }
}

// Called when Jarvis has finished speaking an answer
function afterSpeech() {
  if (conversationActive && autoListen && !listening) {
    clearTimeout(resumeTimer);
    resumeTimer = setTimeout(beginRecognition, 350);
  }
}

// Words that end the hands-free conversation
const END_WORDS = new Set(["stop","stop listening","bye","bye bye","goodbye","good bye","good night","that is all","thats all","exit","quit","enough","go to sleep"]);

function beginRecognition() {
  if (!SR || listening || speaking) return;
  recognition = new SR();
  recognition.lang = "en-US";
  recognition.interimResults = false;
  recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;
  recognition.continuous = false;

  let gotResult = false, fatal = false;
  recognition.onstart = () => { listening = true; updateVoiceUI(); };
  recognition.onresult = e => {
    gotResult = true;
    noSpeechCount = 0;
    processQuery(e.results[0][0].transcript, true);
  };
  recognition.onerror = e => {
    if (e.error === "no-speech") { noSpeechCount++; return; }
    if (e.error === "aborted") return;
    fatal = true;
    conversationActive = false;
    const msgs = {
      "not-allowed": "Microphone access is blocked. Allow the mic in your browser's site settings (voice also needs https:// or localhost, not a plain file).",
      "service-not-allowed": "Microphone access is blocked. Allow the mic in your browser's site settings.",
      "audio-capture": "No microphone found.",
      "network": "Voice recognition needs an internet connection."
    };
    answerEl.textContent = msgs[e.error] || `Voice error: ${e.error}. Please try again.`;
    queryEcho.textContent = "";
  };
  recognition.onend = () => {
    listening = false;
    updateVoiceUI();
    if (!gotResult && !fatal && conversationActive && !speaking) {
      if (noSpeechCount >= 2) {
        stopConversation("I didn't hear anything, Sir. Tap the mic when you want to talk again.");
      } else {
        clearTimeout(resumeTimer);
        resumeTimer = setTimeout(beginRecognition, 300);
      }
    }
  };
  try { recognition.start(); }
  catch (err) { listening = false; conversationActive = false; updateVoiceUI(); }
}

function startListening() {
  if (!SR) return;
  // Tap while listening or while Jarvis is talking in hands-free mode = stop
  if (listening || conversationActive) {
    stopConversation();
    speakId++;                       // cancel any pending "after speech" callback
    speaking = false;
    if (window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    return;
  }
  conversationActive = autoListen;
  noSpeechCount = 0;
  if (window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  speaking = false;
  beginRecognition();
}

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
  if (document.hidden) stopConversation();
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
// SPEECH SYNTHESIS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
let voices = [];
let speakId = 0;
function loadVoices() {
  if (window.speechSynthesis) voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
}
if (window.speechSynthesis) {
  loadVoices();
  window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = loadVoices;
}

function speak(text, onDone) {
  const myId = ++speakId;
  let finished = false;
  const done = () => {
    if (finished || myId !== speakId) return; // ignore stale / cancelled speech
    finished = true;
    speaking = false;
    if (onDone) onDone();
  };
  const clean = text.replace(/\(Closest match:[^)]*\)/g, "").trim();
  speaking = true;
  if (!window.speechSynthesis || !clean) {
    setTimeout(done, window.speechSynthesis ? 50 : Math.min(8000, 800 + clean.length * 60));
    return;
  }
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(clean);
  if (!voices.length) loadVoices();
  const en = voices.filter(v => v.lang && v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith("en"));
  const pick = en.find(v => /male|daniel|david|alex|george|james|fred/i.test(v.name) && !/female/i.test(v.name))
            || en[0] || voices[0];
  if (pick) { utter.voice = pick; utter.lang = pick.lang; }
  utter.rate = 1;
  utter.pitch = 0.9;
  utter.onend = done;
  utter.onerror = done;
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
  // Safety net: some mobile browsers never fire onend
  setTimeout(done, clean.length * 110 + 4000);
}

// iOS/Android only allow speech after a user tap: unlock it on first touch
function unlockSpeech() {
  if (window.speechSynthesis) {
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(" ");
    u.volume = 0;
    window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  }
  window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", unlockSpeech);
}
window.addEventListener("pointerdown", unlockSpeech);
</script>
</body>
</html>
